mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that increase risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias, and trazodone also prolongs QT interval and has anticholinergic effects that increase arrhythmia risk.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes (calcium, magnesium) closely; consider alternative antivirals or antidepressants if QT prolongation develops; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation during foscarnet therapy.
